title: Restriction from fixed coordinates
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $f$ be a function from the $n$-dimensional sign cube to $\{\pm1\}$, let $J$ be a set of coordinates, and let $z$ assign a sign to each coordinate outside $J$. Restricting $f$ according to the coordinates fixed by $z$ and leaving the coordinates in $J$ free is the same function as evaluating $f$ after combining an arbitrary assignment on $J$ with $z$ on the other coordinates.
hypotheses_covered: A Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
A sign assignment on the coordinates outside $J$
